_about: F35: one story moment per rank-up (design/story.md "Story moments, rank by rank"), played at the console between shifts, once per device (Settings → Replay lessons plays them again). Each line: voice mon = Management types it on the monitor · spk = the Veteran's talking bubble over the monitor (Management can cut in: a mon line in the middle of his). words = a key in content/text/en.json story.lines. look = a console part to outline while the moment plays (optional; a part that isn't on the console yet is just left out).
_catchUp: Most moments played in one visit to the console (the newest ones), e.g. after two rank-ups in one shift or on a device that skipped some.
